name: code-supervisor
description: Evidence-based supervision for any side model: defaults to the current worker and validates observations without assuming superior model capability.

verifier_model.title: Verifier model
verifier_model.description: Optional side model ID or host alias. Empty follows the current worker model. No capability ranking or model-ID relationship check; no automatic fallback on refusal.

review_changes.title: Review each turn's change
review_changes.description: At the end of a turn that changed code, the verifier also reads the change for a defect a command can show.

execution_mode.title: Independent execution
execution_mode.description: off by default. shadow runs isolated checks without feedback; enabled sends advisory findings. Uses macOS sandbox-exec or Linux bubblewrap; an opt-in Docker/Podman fallback exists. Unsupported workspaces remain read-only.

assistance_mode.title: Experimental assistance
assistance_mode.description: existing (default), facts (legacy location help), supervise (requirements, plan, architecture, direction and validation review), probe or recovery (single-action review). One shared model flow and budget; record rules remain active.

review_phase.title: Semantic review phase
review_phase.description: Legacy schedule only: auto or plan, exploration, implementation, failure, completion. Defers admission to the selected evidence phase. Incremental schedule does not use this semantic phase gate.

review_schedule.title: Semantic review scheduling
review_schedule.description: incremental (default) captures public callbacks and lets the reviewer choose applicable dimensions; legacy uses review_phase admission. Existing assistance stays unchanged.

review_interval.title: Incremental request interval
review_interval.description: Completed main requests between ordinary opportunities, 1–100. No new material skips the opportunity; key events bypass the interval. Starting value 5 is not an optimized claim.

review_max_calls.title: Semantic calls per user prompt
review_max_calls.description: Finite incremental semantic-call ceiling, 1–100, including optional action followup calls. Default 3 reserves first-write and completion opportunities.

review_output_budget.title: Semantic output reservation
review_output_budget.description: Finite incremental output-token reservation per user prompt, including host allowance, 1–1000000. Default 12000 covers three current Flash wire4000 reservations. No refund or hidden fallback.
